{{Top|leg}}
'''Borte Belgoth''' was the individual who commissioned several [[Hyperspace/Legends|hyperspace]] [[Hyperspace beacon/Legends|beacon]]s, including a particularly elaborately sculpted one, known as [[Belgoth's Beacon]] approximately [[25,100 BBY|25,100 years]] before the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]]. The beacon was later included as one of the [[Twenty Wonders of the Galaxy]] by the [[Historian/Legends|historian]] [[Vicendi]].<ref name="The Essential Atlas">''[[The Essential Atlas]]''</ref>
